slots.founder.bio.1: For two decades, Michael Cassella built high-end apps and websites for elite nightlife and A-list celebrities as founder and CEO of East Coast EFX. When he'd accomplished everything he set out to do, he sold the company and walked away.
slots.founder.bio.2: The break lasted two years. Clients kept calling — nobody could match the quality they'd gotten used to. Rain is his answer: every project run by Michael himself, start to finish. No account managers, no handoffs, no juniors learning on your dime.
